paper.title_en: Gluon GPDs from hard-exclusive electroproduction of heavy quarkonium at NLO
paper.abstract_en: Gluon tomography of the nucleon through hard-exclusive electroproduction of $J/ψ$ has been one of the key motivations for Electron-Ion Collider. However, the next-to-leading order (NLO) perturbative QCD calculations available in the literature were performed either in the collinear factorization limit where the heavy-quark mass is neglected, or in heavy-quark limit where the heavy quarkonia are approximately point-like. We present a full next-to-leading order collinear factorization for the hard exclusive production of heavy mesons that retains the meson mass as well as full light-cone distribution amplitude. We compare the full NLO result with the special limits and estimate the errors due to potentially-large corrections from $α_s(M)$ and $M^2/Q^2$ at this order.
